policytext: Choose the smallest useful action from the evidence already given; do not run a fixed query chain. If an exact, complete small source span is known and no snapshot/hash/coverage evidence is needed, read that span directly. For a known symbol or line whose complete definition or snapshot identity is needed, use read and retain the hash on follow-up. For a supplied Git comparison, start with changes for bounded changed-definition evidence; request --source only when the bodies answer the task, then use reported ranges before broader reads. For an unknown declaration, use find with task terms and inspect its coverage before refining. Normalize an external diagnostic log only when its size, multiple locations or unresolved paths justify task-diagnostics; a tiny already-known log or explicit locations can go directly to targeted reads. Use plan when several definitions and supported environment must compete under one budget, not as a prerequisite to a single known read. Use consumers when the next question is proven callers or references; a signature-environment plan does not establish body-call closure. If evidence is unsupported, ambiguous, stale or insufficient, use focused native search/reads or a justified wider read. Do not reread unchanged retained source or invoke a tool solely because it is available.
baselineguidance: Use the supplied evidence before searching broadly. For a known comparison, inspect its bounded Git diff hunks, then read the relevant complete definitions using targeted ranges. For known small complete spans or explicit diagnostic locations, read them directly. For an unknown entry, use bounded rg searches and refine them before reading source. Broader searches or whole-file reads are allowed when a concrete unanswered question justifies them; a known filename alone is not such a reason. Retain failed attempts and do not reread unchanged source already in context.

evaluation_contract.prompt_cost: Include this policy in the actual measured prompts; record its exact bytes/hash and count its real model-input cost.
evaluation_contract.comparison: Use fresh matched baseline/RepoScout runs with fixed task, fixture, model, harness and binary; record the routing revision. Comparisons to original differently prompted runs are descriptive, not controlled pairs.
evaluation_contract.scope: Preserve the original campaign. Run only the approved single cycle of six matched routing pairs, plus one separately labeled composed-workflow pair. Do not add further optimization cycles or merge composed results into the original six-feature comparison.
evaluation_contract.labeling: Distinguish RepoScout availability from observed invocation. An arm that never invokes RepoScout is availability-only and cannot establish its retrieval effect.
evaluation_contract.quality: Preserve unsuccessful attempts, missing evidence and regressions; no savings claim when quality or completeness fails.
evaluation_contract.authority: This artifact authorizes no runs, model calls or external actions.

composed_instruction: Compare the supplied before and after inventory source using the provided comparison tree. Identify the function whose behavior changed and its direct repository caller or callers. Inspect any local calculation helpers needed to evaluate each direct caller for the supplied inputs, using the after-side behavior. Report evidence for the changed function, each direct caller and the necessary calculation helpers, with exact source ranges. Do not include transitive upstream callers. Return evaluated values in the supplied input order.
composed_variant_guidance: This separately labeled integration-workflow trial must exercise changes, consumers and read. Start with the supplied comparison through changes. Use the changed definition identities actually discovered in that result as incoming-consumers seeds, preserving current-side hash expectations. Read the required caller and calculation-helper definitions through read using returned identity and hash evidence. Do not use expected answer names or guessed selectors, and do not reread unchanged source already retained in context. Focused native fallback is permitted when a reported gap, ambiguity or missing relationship requires it; retain that fallback work in the measured record. This prescribed integration path is not a free-routing trial.
